about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Analilia Mejia

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DISASTER LOAN OUTREACH CONSISTENCY ACT
statements.title: DISASTER LOAN OUTREACH CONSISTENCY ACT
sentences: As climate change fuels more severe storms and flooding, the stakes are really getting higher.
When Hurricane Ida tore through north Jersey in 2021, communities like Montclair, Millburn, and Morristown experienced devastating flooding exacerbated by climate change.
That is why I introduced the Disaster Loan Outreach Consistency Act alongside Representative King-Hinds.
Mr. Speaker, I urge all of my colleagues to support this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOPPING POLITICAL DISCRIMINATION IN DISASTER ASSISTANCE ACT
statements.title: STOPPING POLITICAL DISCRIMINATION IN DISASTER ASSISTANCE ACT
sentences: This is not fiscal responsibility.
Mr. Speaker, I also rise today in support of H.R. 1342, the Stopping Political Discrimination in Disaster Assistance Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill and end the weaponization of FEMA once and for all.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXPANDING SCOTUS
statements.title: EXPANDING SCOTUS
sentences: Ethics reforms and staggered term limits would prevent any single President from stripping the American people of our democracy.

Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to gather the intestinal fortitude to do what is right in this moment because history and the American people are watching. recognizing niheema malloy Mr. Speaker, I rise today to recognize the leadership of Niheema Malloy, the first woman and the first Black woman to serve as chief of police in Maplewood, New Jersey.
Chief Malloy was appointed to this position with over 25 years of law enforcement experience.
Under her leadership, Maplewood would have a department built on community partnership, officers trained in de- escalation, in crisis response, and in listening before a crisis ever happens.
Chief Malloy is committed to putting Maplewood first by ensuring that community safety and protection go hand in hand with the well-being of our residents.

Her leadership reflects the very best of our communities, and I thank her for her remarkable service. congratulating major general christopher d. schneider Mr. Speaker, I rise today to recognize and congratulate Major General Christopher D. Schneider for his new role as the commanding general of Picatinny Arsenal in addition to serving as the portfolio acquisition executive for agile sustainment and ammunition.
He later transitioned to the Army Acquisition Corps, where he held senior leadership positions focused on strengthening our Nation's military capabilities and advancing critical technologies.
I will not watch it happen now.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONGRESS MUST RESPOND
statements.title: CONGRESS MUST RESPOND
sentences: For over a year, this administration pressed that very Commission to require a passport or original birth certificate as a condition for voter registration.

Then, days after the Supreme Court granted the President new authority to remove the heads of independent agencies in a case that had nothing to do with elections, the President used that very authority in order to eliminate every Commissioner.
He alleged a foreign government has compromised the voter data of 220 million Americans and that 278,000 noncitizens were registered to vote.

This Chamber has now watched the same pattern twice: raise unproven claims of fraud, then use them to justify removing the very safeguards standing in the way; first the Commissioners and now a prime-time address built to manufacture support for legislation his own party could not pass on its merits, the SAVE Act.
When Kansas tried a version of this requirement, 31,000 eligible citizens, 12 percent of all applicants, were blocked from registering--not noncitizens, citizens.
Mr. Speaker, this has never been a matter of election integrity.

We must pursue meaningful reform of the Supreme Court, including term limits and enforceable ethical standards because a Court that keeps expanding this President's authority is not exercising oversight.
I will not treat this as acceptable, and I will not stop opposing it. ____________________

statements.title: CONGRESSIONAL OVERSIGHT
sentences: Because of the 14th Amendment, individuals who walked these hallowed Halls were able to fight for marriage equality, bodily autonomy, equal access to public education, public housing, the right to form a union, collectively bargain, and much, much more.

statements.title: BIPARTISAN HOUSING BILL
sentences: Mr. Speaker, yesterday, lawmakers in this chamber came together to pass a bipartisan housing affordability bill aimed at helping American families struggling with rising rents, rising mortgages, and the cost of living.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MAIN STREET COMPETES ACT
statements.title: MAIN STREET COMPETES ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 8882, the Main Street Competes Act.
Mr. Speaker, I speak on behalf of small business owners across New Jersey and across my district, and I urge my colleagues to support H.R. 8882.
